entities.summary: Ángel M. Castro is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Oakland Athletics and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks.
